main_text.p: כְּתָבָא כְּתָב Ch. & Syr. Scriptum, scriptura, inscriptio, liber, libellus, ܟܬܒܐ ܟܬܒܐ Liber Psalmorum, Luc. 20. 42. Plur. ܟܬܒܐ, ܟܬܒܐ, Scripturæ; & synecdochicè, Scripturæ sanctæ: ܟܬܒܐ ܟܬܒܐ Domus scriptorum, id est, Arca libraria, 2. ad Timoth. 4. 13.
כְּתוּבְתָא Chal. Litteræ contractus matrimonialis, Instrumentum dotis; Dos, Gen. 34. 12. in Targ. Hierof. & Genef. 31. 15.
ܟܬܒܐ Syr. Inscriptio. Lucæ 20. 24. Notata sunt in Viennensi exemplari duo puncta supernè, ac si esset numerus pluralis. Plural. ܟܬܒܐ ܟܬܒܐ Scripta, seu elementa prima, ad Hebr. 5. 12.
כְּתַלָא, כְּתַלָא, כּוֹתְלָא, כּוֹתְלִין, כְּתַלְיָא. Chald. Paries. Plural.
כְּתַם Syriac. Maculare, Commaculare, ܟܬܡ Commaculat totū corpus nostrum, Jac. 3. 6.
ܟܬܡܐ Syriac. Maculæ, notæ, signa, stigmata, ad Galat. 6. 17.
* כְּתַנָא כְּתַן Ch. ܟܬܢܐ Syr. Linum: Linteum, Lin-

page.notes: Mixed Hebrew-script Chaldee and Syriac (Estrangela/Serto) words are printed throughout; the Syriac and Hebrew letters above are approximate renderings where the scan is blurred and the vowel points and superscript dots are not fully legible. The line ending "Lin-" continues on the next page.
